toefl:se:427.answer: This depth makes online content more persuasive than a brief, polished TV ad.
toefl:se:427.fullSentence: This depth makes online content more persuasive than a brief, polished TV ad.
keyPhrases: this depth makes online content more persuasive
toefl:se:427.japanese: この情報の深さゆえに、オンラインコンテンツは短く洗練されたテレビ広告よりも説得力があるものになっています。
toefl:se:427.explanation: make A + 比較級で「Aをより〜にする」という使役的表現。
toefl:se:427.relatedInfo: this level of detail makes / more convincing than

toefl:se:428.japanese: 第二に、視聴者の行動は変化しました。
toefl:se:428.explanation: has changedは現在完了で過去から現在への変化の結果を表す。
toefl:se:428.relatedInfo: the way audiences behave has shifted

toefl:se:429.answer: Many people now stream shows on platforms that either remove traditional commercials or allow viewers to skip them.
toefl:se:429.fullSentence: Many people now stream shows on platforms that either remove traditional commercials or allow viewers to skip them.
keyPhrases: remove traditional commercials or allow viewers to skip them
toefl:se:429.japanese: 多くの人々は今では、従来型のコマーシャルを取り除くか視聴者がスキップできるようにしているプラットフォームで番組を配信視聴しています。
toefl:se:429.explanation: either A or Bで「AかBのどちらか」。that以下はplatformsを修飾する関係代名詞節。
toefl:se:429.relatedInfo: watch shows on streaming platforms / let viewers skip ads

toefl:se:430.answer: As a result, even if companies spend heavily on television, a smaller portion of the population actually watches those ads attentively.
toefl:se:430.fullSentence: As a result, even if companies spend heavily on television, a smaller portion of the population actually watches those ads attentively.
keyPhrases: even if companies spend heavily on television
toefl:se:430.japanese: その結果、企業がテレビに多額の費用をかけたとしても、実際に注意を払ってその広告を見ている人の割合は少なくなっています。
toefl:se:430.explanation: even if〜は「たとえ〜でも」という譲歩を表す。
toefl:se:430.relatedInfo: invest heavily in TV / pay close attention to those ads

toefl:se:431.answer: Andrew raises an interesting point that television might introduce products initially.
toefl:se:431.fullSentence: Andrew raises an interesting point that television might introduce products initially.
toefl:se:431.japanese: アンドリューは、テレビが最初に商品を紹介する役割を果たすかもしれないという興味深い指摘をしています。
toefl:se:431.explanation: raise a pointで「意見・指摘を述べる」という表現。
toefl:se:431.relatedInfo: makes an interesting point / could be the first to introduce products

toefl:se:432.answer: However, today that introductory role is increasingly played by social media influencers, targeted online ads, and viral content.
toefl:se:432.fullSentence: However, today that introductory role is increasingly played by social media influencers, targeted online ads, and viral content.
keyPhrases: that introductory role is increasingly played by
toefl:se:432.japanese: しかし今日では、その紹介役はソーシャルメディアのインフルエンサーやターゲット広告、バイラルコンテンツによってますます担われるようになっています。
toefl:se:432.explanation: be played by〜で「〜によって担われる」という受動態表現。
toefl:se:432.relatedInfo: is increasingly taken on by / targeted advertising

toefl:se:433.answer: These channels reach specific audiences more efficiently and often feel more authentic than conventional TV spots.
toefl:se:433.fullSentence: These channels reach specific audiences more efficiently and often feel more authentic than conventional TV spots.
keyPhrases: more authentic than conventional tv spots
toefl:se:433.japanese: これらのチャネルは特定の視聴者層により効率的に届き、従来のテレビCMよりも本物らしく感じられることが多いです。
toefl:se:433.explanation: feel + 形容詞で「〜のように感じられる」という表現。
toefl:se:433.relatedInfo: target specific audiences more effectively / more genuine than traditional TV ads

toefl:se:434.explanation: Dear + 名前、は手紙・メールの一般的な書き出し。

toefl:se:435.answer: Unfortunately, I just found out that my apartment building will be conducting fire alarm tests on the evening we planned to have our game night.
toefl:se:435.fullSentence: Unfortunately, I just found out that my apartment building will be conducting fire alarm tests on the evening we planned to have our game night.
toefl:se:435.japanese: 残念ながら、私たちがゲームナイトを予定していた夜に、私のアパートで火災報知器のテストが行われることが分かりました。
toefl:se:435.explanation: just found out that〜で「〜だと分かった」という予期せぬ判明を表す。
toefl:se:435.relatedInfo: just learned that / carry out fire alarm tests

toefl:se:436.answer: Because of the noise and interruptions, I don't think it will work out as planned.
toefl:se:436.fullSentence: Because of the noise and interruptions, I don't think it will work out as planned.
toefl:se:436.japanese: 騒音や中断があるため、予定通りにはいかないと思います。
toefl:se:436.explanation: work out as plannedで「予定通りにうまくいく」という意味。
toefl:se:436.relatedInfo: go as planned / turn out as expected

toefl:se:437.answer: Would you like to reschedule for another day, or maybe we could have board game night at your place instead?
toefl:se:437.fullSentence: Would you like to reschedule for another day, or maybe we could have board game night at your place instead?
toefl:se:437.japanese: 別の日に予定を変更しますか、それとも代わりにあなたの家でボードゲームナイトをするのはどうでしょうか。
toefl:se:437.explanation: instead は「代わりに」と代替案を提示する際に文末に置く。
toefl:se:437.relatedInfo: postpone to another day / host it at your place

toefl:se:438.answer: Please let me know what time or location works best for you.
toefl:se:438.fullSentence: Please let me know what time or location works best for you.
toefl:se:438.japanese: どの時間や場所が一番都合良いか教えてください。
toefl:se:438.explanation: works best for youで「あなたにとって最も都合が良い」という意味。

toefl:se:439.answer: I am looking forward to hearing from you.
toefl:se:439.fullSentence: I am looking forward to hearing from you.
keyPhrases: looking forward to hearing from you
toefl:se:439.japanese: ご連絡をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:439.explanation: look forward to -ingで「〜を楽しみにする」。

toefl:se:440.explanation: Kind regards,はメールの結びに使う丁寧な定型表現。

toefl:se:441.explanation: Dear + 名前、は手紙・メールの一般的な書き出し。

toefl:se:442.japanese: お元気でお過ごしのことと思います。
toefl:se:442.explanation: メール冒頭の定番の挨拶表現。
toefl:se:442.relatedInfo: I hope this email finds you well.

toefl:se:443.answer: I'm writing about our planned board game night this Friday.
toefl:se:443.fullSentence: I'm writing about our planned board game night this Friday.
toefl:se:443.japanese: 今週金曜日に予定しているボードゲームナイトについてご連絡しています。
toefl:se:443.explanation: I'm writing about 〜で「〜についてお伝えします」と用件を切り出す表現。
toefl:se:443.relatedInfo: I'm writing regarding / I'm contacting you about

toefl:se:444.answer: I just found out that my apartment building will be conducting fire alarm tests on Friday evening, and they may continue for several hours.
toefl:se:444.fullSentence: I just found out that my apartment building will be conducting fire alarm tests on Friday evening, and they may continue for several hours.
toefl:se:444.japanese: 金曜日の夜に私のアパートで火災報知器のテストが行われ、それが数時間続く可能性があることが分かりました。
toefl:se:444.explanation: may continue for〜で「〜の間続く可能性がある」という推量を表す。

toefl:se:445.answer: Given the loud noise and interruptions expected during the tests, hosting the game night at my place will likely not work as planned.
toefl:se:445.fullSentence: Given the loud noise and interruptions expected during the tests, hosting the game night at my place will likely not work as planned.
keyPhrases: given the loud noise and interruptions
will likely not work as planned
toefl:se:445.japanese: テスト中に大きな騒音や中断が予想されるため、私の家でゲームナイトを開くのはおそらく予定通りにはいかないでしょう。
toefl:se:445.explanation: Given 〜で「〜を踏まえると」と理由を前置きする表現。

toefl:se:446.answer: To ensure we can still have an enjoyable time together, we could either move the event to your place or reschedule it for Saturday evening at my apartment.
toefl:se:446.fullSentence: To ensure we can still have an enjoyable time together, we could either move the event to your place or reschedule it for Saturday evening at my apartment.
keyPhrases: to ensure we can still have an enjoyable time
move the event to your place
toefl:se:446.japanese: それでも楽しい時間を一緒に過ごせるように、イベントをあなたの家に移すか、土曜日の夜に私のアパートで予定を変更することができます。
toefl:se:446.explanation: To ensure〜で「〜を確実にするために」と目的を示す。
toefl:se:446.relatedInfo: to make sure we can still enjoy

toefl:se:447.answer: If neither of these options work, we could also look for a cozy café nearby that allows board games, so we don't miss out on the fun.
toefl:se:447.fullSentence: If neither of these options work, we could also look for a cozy café nearby that allows board games, so we don't miss out on the fun.
keyPhrases: if neither of these options work
don't miss out on the fun
toefl:se:447.japanese: どちらの案も難しければ、ボードゲームができる近くの居心地の良いカフェを探すこともできます。そうすれば楽しみを逃さずに済みます。
toefl:se:447.explanation: miss out on〜で「〜を逃す」という意味。
toefl:se:447.relatedInfo: if neither works / don't miss the fun

toefl:se:448.answer: Please let me know what you think, and I'll do my best to accommodate any preferences you have.
toefl:se:448.fullSentence: Please let me know what you think, and I'll do my best to accommodate any preferences you have.
toefl:se:448.japanese: どう思うか教えてください。あなたの希望にできる限り合わせるようにします。
toefl:se:448.explanation: accommodate〜で「〜に対応する、応じる」という意味。

toefl:se:449.answer: Looking forward to our time together!
toefl:se:449.fullSentence: Looking forward to our time together!
keyPhrases: looking forward to our time together
toefl:se:449.japanese: 一緒に過ごす時間を楽しみにしています！
toefl:se:449.explanation: Looking forward to〜！で締めくくる親しみのある表現。
toefl:se:449.relatedInfo: can't wait to spend time together

toefl:se:450.explanation: Best,はカジュアルなメールの結びの定型表現。

toefl:se:451.japanese: カスタマーサポート様、
toefl:se:451.explanation: Dear Customer Support,は問い合わせメールの一般的な書き出し。
